question: There are 49 members in group A, 35 members in group B and 31 members in group C. All the members of these groups went to a restaurant. The average amount spent on each member of group A, B and C is ₹106, ₹141 and ₹226, respectively. The total average amount (in ₹) spent per member is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed average be ₹141 (Average of Group B).

Net deviation = [49 × (106 − 141)] + [35 × (141 − 141)] + [31 × (226 − 141)]

⇒ Net deviation = 49 × (−35) + 0 + 31 × 85 = −1715 + 2635 = +920

Average deviation = +920 ÷ (49 + 35 + 31) = +920 ÷ 115 = +8

Actual average = Assumed average + Average deviation = 141 + 8 = 149

**∴ The correct answer is ₹149.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of members in Group A = 49, Average amount = ₹106

Number of members in Group B = 35, Average amount = ₹141

Number of members in Group C = 31, Average amount = ₹226

**Formula Used:**

Total Average = Total Amount ÷ Total Members
